title: Coordinate cap bound
statement: Let $n\ge1$, let $C,Q$ be nonnegative integers, let $t>0$ be rational, and let $0<\varepsilon\le1/2$ be rational. Suppose $1/(Q+1)\le\varepsilon$ and $t\le(C+1)(\sqrt{\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1)$. Define $d=\lceil 8t/\varepsilon\rceil$ and $T=(\varepsilon/8)^2t^{-2}(1/9)^d$. Then the coordinate cap $\lceil 2t/T\rceil$, increased by one, is at most $2^{K(\sqrt{\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1)}$, where $K=128(Q+1)^2(C+1)^3+4(8(C+1)(Q+1)+1)+5$.
